blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Old-growth forests develop over centuries under minimal anthropogenic disturbance, producing structurally complex and biodiverse stands. In Europe, protecting them requires mapping that is accurate for individual forest parcels yet deployable continent-wide. Geospatial foundation model (GFM) embeddings enable label-scarce land classification, but their value for old-growth detection remains unknown. Here, we map old-growth forests across 211,893 ha of Romania’s Southern Carpathians, a beech–spruce landscape typical of the Alpine Biogeographic Region. We construct high-confidence, expert-informed reference labels for old-growth and non-old-growth parcels. We add AlphaEarth, TESSERA v2 and Sentinel-1/2 features to a common baseline of topographic and human-access predictors, then compare them under spatially blocked validation with and without 10 km train-test buffers to limit residual autocorrelation. With buffering, GFM and Sentinel-1/2 predictors increase precision-recall AUC by 0.21–0.25 [95% CIs: 0.15–0.34] relative to baseline, indicating spectral data contain a spatially robust old-growth signal. With a PR-AUC of 0.84 [0.79–0.88] , TESSERA outperforms Sentinel-1/2 ( + + 0.08 [ + + 0.05 to + + 0.11] ) and AlphaEarth ( + + 0.08 [ + + 0.04 to + + 0.12] ) under unbuffered spatial validation. At a 10 km buffer, however, this advantage narrows to + + 0.04 [ − - 0.01 to + + 0.11] and + + 0.03 [ − - 0.04 to + + 0.10] , intervals consistent with no difference. At 10 m resolution, convolutional neural networks add no benefit over pixel-based XGBoost. Comparisons with four national- and continental-scale products show the importance of non-old-growth labels, and reveal 81% agreement between our predictions and a field-calibrated map. We conclude that buffered spatial validation is vital when transferring old-growth detection models to unseen landscapes, and provide our labels and predictions for future work.
blocks.zh: 数百年来,古老的森林在人类活动最小的扰动下发展起来,产生了结构复杂和生物多样化的柱子。 在欧洲,保护森林需要绘制准确的地图,用于整个大陆的单个森林地块。 地理空间基础模型(GFM)嵌入使得标签稀缺的土地分类成为可能,但其对于旧生长探测值仍然未知. 这里,我们绘制了罗马尼亚南部喀尔巴阡山脉211,893公顷的古老生长森林图,这是阿尔卑斯生物地理区典型的山毛ech地貌。 我们为老成长和非老成长的包裹建立了高自信、专家知情的参考标签。 我们把AlphaEarth,TESSERA v2和Sentinel-1/2等特征添加到地形和人类接入预测器的共同基线中,然后在空间屏蔽的验证下将它们与和没有10公里的列车测试缓冲器进行对比,以限制剩余自失能关系. 随着缓冲作用,GFM和Sentinel-1/2预测器将精确召回AUC比基线增加0.21–0.25[95%CIS:0.15–0.34],表明光谱数据含有空间坚固的老生长信号. PR-AUC为0.84 [0.79–0.88],TESSERA优于Sentinel-1/2(+ + 0.08 [+ 0.05–+ + + 0.11])和α地球(+ + 0.08 [+ 0.04–+ + + + 0.12])在无阻空间验证下. 然而,在10公里缓冲线上,这种优势缩小到++0.04[−−−−0.01−++0.11]和++0.03[−−−0.04−+++0.10],间隔不差. 在10m解析度,革命神经网络比基于像素的XGBoost没有任何好处. 与4个国家级和大陆级产品的比较显示非老式生长标签的重要性,并揭示出我们预测和实地校准地图之间81%的一致度. 我们的结论是,在将老的生长探测模型转移到看不见的景观时,缓冲空间验证至关重要,并为今后的工作提供我们的标签和预测。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: Temperate old-growth forests are valuable ecosystems characterised by large old trees, structural complexity and high biodiversity ( Spies, 2004 ; Wirth et al., 2009 ) . They provide critical ecosystem services, from carbon storage ( Keith et al., 2009 ) and sequestration ( Luyssaert et al., 2008 ) to microclimate buffering ( Frey et al., 2016 ) and water-flow regulation ( Jones et al., 2022 ) . While ‘primary’ forests must have no clearly visible indications of human activity ( FAO, 2020 ) , the term ‘old-growth’ encompasses forests that show minimal signs of past anthropogenic disturbance, provided their natural structures and processes are not significantly altered ( European Commission, 2023 ) . This makes old-growth forests of considerable interest for European forest conservation, and the EU Biodiversity Strategy for 2030 prioritises old-growth alongside primary forests for mapping, monitoring and protection ( European Commission, 2021 ) . However, these forests are small and fragmented ( Barredo et al., 2021 ) , and detecting them requires a method that is accurate for individual parcels yet deployable continent-wide.
blocks.zh: 温带的老森林是以大型老树、结构复杂性和高度生物多样性为特点的宝贵生态系统(Spies,2004年;Wirth等人,2009年)。 它们提供重要的生态系统服务,从碳储存(Keith等人,2009年)和固存(Luyssaert等人,2008年)到微观气候缓冲(Frey等人,2016年)和水流调节(Jones等人,2022年)。 虽然 " 主要 " 森林必须没有明显的人类活动迹象(粮农组织,2020年),但 " 旧生长 " 一词包括过去人类活动扰动迹象微乎其微的森林,只要其自然结构和过程没有明显改变(欧洲联盟委员会,2023年)。 这使得旧生长的森林对欧洲森林养护具有相当大的兴趣,欧盟2030年生物多样性战略将旧生长与原始森林并列,用于绘图、监测和保护(欧洲联盟委员会,2021年)。 然而,这些森林规模小,支离破碎(Barredo 等人,2021年),要探测这些森林,需要一种准确的方法,用于个别的、但可在全大陆部署的包裹。

blocks.en: Remote sensing approaches for mapping old-growth forests generally fall into two groups (adapted from Hirschmugl et al., 2023 ). The first uses interpretable forest metrics, such as tree height and structural complexity, typically from airborne laser scanning (ALS) data. Old-growth conditions are then identified using expert-defined thresholds (e.g. Trouvé et al., 2024 ) or supervised models trained on these metrics alongside Earth observation (EO)-derived features (e.g. Lalechère et al., 2024 ; Adiningrat et al., 2024 ; Hirschmugl et al., 2026 ). The second approach uses supervised models to detect old-growth forests directly from EO data, without extracting interpretable forest metrics (e.g. Spracklen & Spracklen, 2019 ; Munteanu et al., 2022 ). Both approaches often incorporate non-EO geospatial predictors of old-growth forest such as topography and transport access ( Mikoláš et al., 2019 ) , and these frequently rank as important features ( Bubnicki et al., 2024 ; Lalechère et al., 2024 ) . Input data are predominantly organised at the pixel, plot or parcel level, with features passed to a model such as a decision tree. While some studies use texture features (e.g. Hirschmugl et al., 2026 ; Lalechère et al., 2024 ; Spracklen & Spracklen, 2019 ), models that use spatial context, such as convolutional neural networks (CNNs), are not routinely used for old-growth detection ( Hirschmugl et al., 2023 ; Web of Science search, see Section S1 of the supplementary material), despite horizontal structural complexity being indicative of old-growth conditions ( Spies, 2004 ) .
blocks.zh: 绘制老林图的遥感方法一般分为两类(改编自Hirschmugl等人,2023年)。 第一种方法使用可解释的森林度量衡,如树高和结构复杂度,一般来自空中激光扫描(ALS)数据. 然后利用专家确定的阈值(如Trouvé等人,2024年)或与地球观测(EO)衍生的特征一起对这些计量标准进行培训的监管模型(如Lalechère等人,2024年;Adiningrat等人,2024年;Hirschmugl等人,2026年)确定老生长条件。 第二种方法使用有监督的模型直接从EO数据中检测老林,而不提取可解释的森林度量衡(例如Spracklen & Spracklen,2019年;Munteanu等人,2022年)。 这两种方法往往都包括了对老森林的非EO地理空间预测器,如地形学和运输通道(Mikoláč等人,2019年),这些常被列为重要特征(Bubnicki等人,2024年;Lalechère等人,2024年)。 输入数据主要按像素,图案或包裹级别排列,特征传递给决策树等模型. 虽然有些研究使用纹理特征(如Hirschmugl等人,2026年;Lalechère等人,2024年;Spracklen & Spracklen,2019年),但使用空间背景的模型,如演化神经网络(CNNs),并非经常用于老生长检测(Hirschmugl等人,2023年;科学搜索网,见补充材料S1节),尽管横向结构复杂性表明老生长条件(Spies,2004年).

blocks.en: Existing studies differ in their prediction objectives and spatial scales, making intercomparison challenging. Prediction objectives include binary old-growth/non-old-growth forest classification (e.g. Adiningrat et al., 2024 ; Adiningrat et al., 2025 ; Spracklen & Spracklen, 2019 ), categorical classification of succession or developmental stages (e.g. Falkowski et al., 2009 ; Martin & Valeria, 2022 ), as well as continuous indices of forest maturity, primary forest likelihood, and forest structural complexity (e.g. Fuhr et al., 2022 ; Lalechère et al., 2024 ; Sabatini, 2020 ; Munteanu et al., 2022 ; Bubnicki et al., 2024 ). Spatial scales vary from individual forest plots (e.g. Adiningrat et al., 2025 ; Fuhr et al., 2022 ; Lalechère et al., 2024 ) to national (e.g. Munteanu et al., 2022 ; Bubnicki et al., 2024 ) and continental ( Sabatini, 2020 , although this study uses non-EO geospatial predictors only).
blocks.zh: 现有研究在预测目标和空间尺度上有所不同,使得相互比较具有挑战性. 预测目标包括二进制旧生长/非旧生长森林分类(如Adiningrat等人,2024年;Adiningrat等人,2025年;Spracklen & Spracklen,2019年),继承或发育阶段的绝对分类(如Falkowski等人,2009年;Martin & Valeria,2022年),以及森林成熟程度、原始森林可能性和森林结构复杂性的连续指数(如Fuhr等人,2022年;Lalechère等人,2024年;Sabatini,2024年)。 2020年; Munteanu等人,2022年;Bubnicki等人,2024年。 空间尺度从单个森林地块(例如Adiningrat等人,2025年;Fuhr等人,2022年;Lalechère等人,2024年)到国家地块(例如Munteanu等人,2022年;Bubnicki等人,2024年)和大陆地块(Sabatini,2020年,尽管本研究仅使用非地球空间预测器)。

blocks.en: Many studies rely on ALS-derived features as a structural signature of old-growth forests ( Hirschmugl et al., 2023 ) . Although ALS features are effective predictors ( Adiningrat et al., 2024 ; Lalechère et al., 2024 ) , many countries lack national surveys and obtaining ALS data can be resource-intensive, limiting widespread adoption. In contrast, free and open satellite data, including from the Sentinel and Landsat missions ( Torres et al., 2012 ; Drusch et al., 2012 ; Wulder et al., 2019 ) , offer global coverage and support monitoring and mapping with lower ongoing costs. Geospatial foundation model (GFM) embeddings offer an alternative to hand-crafted EO features. GFMs are trained on large multi-sensor, multi-temporal remote sensing datasets ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) and models such as AlphaEarth ( Brown et al., 2025 ) and TESSERA ( Feng et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2026a ) provide analysis-ready embeddings designed for label-scarce land classification. However, the value of GFM embeddings over established approaches for old-growth detection is not yet known.
blocks.zh: 许多研究依靠ALS衍生的特征作为老生长森林的结构标志(Hirschmugl等人,2023年)。 虽然ALS特征是有效的预测器(Adiningrat等人,2024年;Lalechère等人,2024年),但许多国家缺乏国家调查,获取ALS数据可能是资源密集型的,限制了广泛采用. 相比之下,免费和开放的卫星数据,包括来自哨兵卫星和大地卫星飞行任务的数据(Torres等人,2012年;Drusch等人,2012年;Wulder等人,2019年),提供了全球覆盖,支持监测和测绘,持续费用较低。 地理空间基础模型(GFM)嵌入提供了一种替代手工制作的EO特征. GFM接受大型多传感器,多时遥感数据集(Xiao等人,2025年)以及AlphaEarth(Brown等人,2025年)和TESSERA(Feng等人,2026年;Feng等人,2026年a)等模型的培训,提供为标签-稀缺土地分类设计的分析准备嵌入. 然而,GFM嵌入旧生长探测既定方法的价值尚不清楚。

blocks.en: Like many environmental features, old-growth forests are highly spatially clustered ( Mikoláš et al., 2019 ) , and their environmental predictors follow smooth gradients ( Legendre, 1993 ) . Spatial autocorrelation between the data on which a model is fitted and evaluated violates the independence assumption of most statistical methods, inflating reported performance and weakening the transfer of conclusions beyond the study area ( Legendre, 1993 ; Ploton et al., 2020 ; Kattenborn et al., 2022 ) . However, few existing old-growth mapping studies explicitly account for spatial autocorrelation, a gap that extends across GFM research more broadly ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 与许多环境特征一样,旧生长的森林在空间上高度集中(Mikoláš等人,2019年),其环境预测器遵循平滑梯度(Legendre,1993年). 安装和评价模型的数据之间的空间自动关系违反了大多数统计方法的独立性假设,夸大了报告的表现,削弱了结论在研究领域以外的转移(Legendre,1993年;Ploton等人,2020年;Kattenborn等人,2022年)。 然而,现有的旧生长图绘制研究很少明确说明空间自发性关系,这一差距更广泛地贯穿了GFM研究(周等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Here, we detect old-growth forests using only freely available EO data, with spatial validation and buffering based on measured autocorrelation (Fig. 1 ). We use detailed forest parcel data to construct high-confidence reference labels for both old-growth and non-old-growth forests in our study area. We compare the performance of Sentinel-1/2-derived features (hereafter, conventional EO) with AlphaEarth and TESSERA v2 embeddings, controlling for topographic and access (e.g. distance to road) covariates. To our knowledge, this is the first evaluation of GFM embeddings for old-growth forest detection (Web of Science search, Section S1 of the supplementary material).
blocks.zh: 在此,我们仅利用可自由获取的EO数据探测出老林,并基于测量的自旋关系进行空间验证和缓冲(图1)。 我们利用详细的森林包裹数据,为我们的研究地区老林和非老林区构建高自信的参考标签。 我们把哨兵-1/2衍生特征(以下简称常规EO)的性能与AlphaEarth和TESSERA v2嵌入物进行比较,控制地形和出入(如与道路的距离)共变. 据我们所知,这是对用于旧生长森林探测的GFM嵌入的首次评价(科学搜索网,补充材料S1节)。

blocks.en: Our study area is the Făgăraş Mountains in Romania, one of the largest primary and old-growth forested landscapes in temperate Europe ( Kameniar et al., 2023 ) . The forests are dominated by European beech ( Fagus sylvatica ) and Norway spruce ( Picea abies ), with some intermixed silver fir ( Abies alba ) ( Kameniar et al., 2023 ) , typical of the wider Alpine Biogeographic Region ( Sundseth & European Commission, 2009 ) . The landscape’s rugged topography and mixed land use make it a challenging and representative test case for old-growth detection in Europe ( Sabatini et al., 2018 ) . Four existing national and continental studies map old-growth or similar forests in the study area, two derived from machine learning ( Sabatini, 2020 ; Munteanu et al., 2022 ) and two from expert inspection and thresholding ( Kathmann et al., 2017 ; Schickhofer & Schwarz, 2019 ) ; however, their estimates of old-growth forest extent vary threefold from 20,865 ha to 64,146 ha (Section 3.1 ). In this paper, we (1) evaluate the agreement of these maps with our locally verified labels, motivating a revised modelling approach; (2) investigate to what extent EO data, including GFM embeddings, can detect old-growth forests beyond topographic and access covariates; and (3) test whether introducing spatial context through a CNN model architecture improves performance. Finally, we map old-growth forests across the entire study area and provide vector and raster layers to support future research.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究地区是罗马尼亚的Făgăraş山脉,是温带欧洲最大的原始和古老的森林景观之一(Kameniar等人,2023年)。 森林以欧洲海蜂(Fagus sylvatica)和挪威海蜂(Picea abies)为主,其中有一些混合的银丝(Abies alba). (Kameniar等人,2023年),典型的大阿尔卑斯生物地理区(Sundseth & European Committee,2009年). 地貌地形崎岖,土地混合使用,成为欧洲旧生长探测具有挑战性和代表性的试验案例(Sabatini等人,2018年)。 现有4种国家和大陆研究绘制了研究区内的老生长或类似森林图,2种来源于机器学习(Sabatini,2020年;Munteanu等人,2022年),2种来源于专家检查和阈值(Kathmann等人,2017年;Schickhofer & Schwarz,2019年);然而,他们对老生长森林面积的估计从20,865公顷到64,146公顷不等(第3.1节)。 在本文中,我们 (1) 评估这些地图与我们在当地核实的标签的一致程度,推动采用订正的建模方法; (2) 调查EO数据,包括GFM嵌入数据,在多大程度上能够探测到地形和接触共变物以外的老森林; (3) 测试通过CNN模型架构引入空间环境是否提高了性能. 最后,我们绘制整个研究地区的老森林图,并提供矢量层和光栅层,以支持未来的研究。

blocks.en: 2. Materials and methods
blocks.zh: 2. 材料和方法

blocks.en: 2.1. Study area
blocks.zh: 2.1. 研究领域

blocks.en: The area of interest (AOI) is the Făgăraş Mountains in Romania’s Southern Carpathians (Fig. 1 ), operationally delineated by the union of the Munţii Făgăraş and Râul Târgului–Argeşel–Râuşor Natura 2000 sites ( EEA, 2025 ) . Elevations range from 343 m to 2,523 m above sea level (own analysis of Hawker et al., 2022 ) , peaking at Vârful Moldoveanu , the highest mountain in Romania. Forests cover 152,366 ha (71.9%) of the 211,893 ha AOI, comprising broadleaf (14.2% of the AOI, median elevation 921 m), mixed (30.9%, 1,136 m) and coniferous (26.8%, 1,498 m) (own analysis of CLMS, 2020 ; Hawker et al., 2022 ) . The landscape follows a vegetation gradient typical of the Southern Carpathians, with broadleaf forests dominated by European beech ( Fagus sylvatica ) at lower elevations, transitioning at higher elevations to coniferous forests, dominated by Norway spruce ( Picea abies ) and, to a lesser extent, silver fir ( Abies alba ) ( Kameniar et al., 2023 ) . Heathland and natural grassland account for a further 22.9% of the AOI and occur predominantly above 1,900 m. The ecosystem hosts high levels of biodiversity, with preliminary surveys identifying over 2,000 animal, plant, fungal and lichen species ( Linnell et al., 2016 ) , including a dense community of large carnivores such as brown bears ( Ursus arctos ), Eurasian lynx ( Lynx lynx ) and grey wolves ( Canis lupus ) ( Dyck et al., 2022 ; Iosif et al., 2022 ) .

blocks.en: 2.2. Reference label construction
blocks.zh: 2.2. 参考标签构建

blocks.en: We constructed reference labels of old-growth forest (OGF) and non-old-growth forest (non-OGF) parcels within the AOI by applying a rule-based data fusion procedure to forest management, infrastructure and disturbance datasets (Table 1 ). Unlike presence-only approaches that rely on pseudo-absences or background points, we constructed explicit non-OGF labels to reduce label noise and enable false-positive estimation, addressing a key limitation identified by Bubnicki et al. (2024) . A map of 15,515 forest parcels covering 92.1% of the forested area within the AOI served as a base geometry (Table 1 b), and the parcel attributes were augmented with data from seven forest management plan vector layers dated from 2013 to 2025 (Table 1 c). Where conflicts occurred, the forest management plan for the year closest to 2020, our reference year, was prioritised. The resulting parcel map contained average stand-age attributes for 9,402 parcels (61%).
blocks.zh: 我们通过对森林管理、基础设施和扰动数据集采用基于规则的数据聚合程序,在AOI内建立了老林和非老林区(非老林区)的参考标签(表1)。 与依赖伪缺点或背景点的仅存在法不同,我们构建了明确的非OGF标签以减少标签噪声并允许虚假阳性估计,解决了Bubnicki等人(2024年)确定的关键限制. 一份覆盖AOI内92.1%森林面积的15 515个森林地块的地图作为基数几何(表1b),该地块的属性因2013年至2025年7个森林管理计划矢量层的数据而有所扩大(表1c)。 在发生冲突的地方,将最接近2020年的森林管理计划列为优先事项。 由此产生的包裹图包含9 402个包裹的平均站龄属性(61%)。

blocks.en: Conservative filters were applied to the parcels to assign high-confidence reference labels. We labelled parcels as OGF if at least 90% of their area overlapped with a vector layer of ‘virgin’ or ‘quasi-virgin’ forests confirmed by forestry experts at Fundaţia Conservation Carpathia (FCC), a conservation organisation operating in the AOI (Table 1 d). Under Romanian law, virgin and quasi-virgin forests are defined more strictly than old-growth ( MMediu, 2020a ) and therefore serve as a conservative reference for the OGF class. Overlapping parcels with a recorded stand age below 80 years or whose attribute comments included disturbance flags were excluded. Roads and footpaths (with a 10 m buffer) and European Forest Disturbance Atlas pixels (1985–2020) were clipped from the OGF parcel geometries to reduce label noise (Table 1 e–f).
blocks.zh: 保护过滤器被应用到包裹上,以指定高自信的参考标签. 如果至少90%的面积与Fundaţia养护喀尔巴阡山林业专家确认的 " virgin " 或 " quasi-virgin " 森林的矢量层重叠,我们则将其标为 " OGF " 。 Fundaţia养护喀尔巴阡山森林养护组织(AOI养护组织)(表1d)。 根据罗马尼亚法律,处女林和准紫杉林的定义比老生长林更严格(Mmediu,2020a),因此是OGF类的保守参考. 将记录年龄低于80岁或其属性评论包括扰动旗帜的重叠包裹排除在外。 道路和人行道(带有10米缓冲器)和欧洲森林扰动图集像素(1985-2020年)从OGF包裹的几何仪中剪接,以减少标签噪音(表1 e-f)。

blocks.en: We labelled the remaining parcels with a recorded average stand age of 80 years or less as non-OGF. Under Romanian silvicultural regulations, beech stands below this age are typically eligible for active thinning ( Bouriaud et al., 2019 ) , and evidence from protected Romanian mountain forests indicates that old-growth characteristics do not fully recover within 80 years of the last harvest ( Barbu et al., 2023 ) . The 80-year threshold was used to identify high-confidence negatives, not to define old-growth forests. Therefore, forest parcels older than 80 years received no age-defined label and could be classified by the model as either OGF or non-OGF. Roads, footpaths and disturbances, each independently identifiable from open datasets (Table 1 ), were retained as non-OGF rather than clipped.
blocks.zh: 我们把记录的平均站龄为80岁或以下的其余包裹标为非OGF。 根据罗马尼亚的造林条例,低于这一年龄的海鸟一般有资格活化(Bouriaud等人,2019年),来自受保护的罗马尼亚山地森林的证据表明,在上次收获后80年内,老生长特征没有完全恢复(Barbu等人,2023年)。 80年的门槛用于确定高自信负数,而不是定义老森林。 因此,80岁以上的森林地块没有经过年龄界定的标签,可以被模型归类为OGF或非OGF. 道路、人行道和扰动,从开放数据集中独立识别(表1),被保留为非OGF,而不是剪辑。

blocks.en: The resulting reference labels comprised 1,016 OGF and 3,837 non-OGF parcels, covering 12,775 ha (8.4%) and 34,574 ha (22.7%) of the forested AOI, respectively (Fig. 1 a). Compared with non-OGF parcels, OGF parcels were typically located at higher altitudes, on steeper slopes and further from roads (Fig. S1 ). This distribution held for coniferous, broadleaf and mixed parcels, and aligned with expected patterns ( Mikoláš et al., 2019 ) . Further details on the reference label construction are provided in Section S2.1 of the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 由此产生的参考标签包括1,016个OGF和3,837个非OGF包裹,分别覆盖了12,775公顷(8.4%)和34,574公顷(22.7%)的森林中AOI(图1a)。 与非OGF包裹相比,OGF包裹一般位于较高的海拔,较陡峭的山坡上,离道路更远(图S1)。 这种分布为圆叶、阔叶和混合包裹,并与预期模式相一致(Mikolác等人,2019年)。 补充材料S2.1节提供了参考标签的更多细节。

blocks.en: 2.3. Performance metrics
blocks.zh: 2.3. 业绩计量

blocks.en: The study used a common 10 m pixel grid in the coordinate reference system EPSG:3035. Forest parcels, not pixels, are the units of management within the AOI and are more relevant for evaluating a model’s usefulness. We therefore calculated parcel-level metrics by comparing each reference parcel’s label (OGF = 1, non-OGF = 0) with the unweighted mean of the predictions (0, 1 or 0–1) for all pixels fully enclosed by that parcel. This process excluded 28 parcels in which no pixel was fully enclosed. Parcel-level results were reported for the remaining 4,825 parcels.
blocks.zh: 该研究在坐标参考系统EPSG:3035中使用了常用的10米像素网格. 森林包裹,而不是像素,是AOI内部的管理单位,更适合评价一个模型的有用性. 因此,我们通过比较每个参考包裹的标签(OGF = 1,非OGF = 0)和该包裹全部封装的所有像素的未加权预测平均值(0, 1 或 0-1)来计算包裹的度量。 这个过程不包括28个包裹,其中没有像素被完全封闭. 报告其余4 825个包裹的分层结果。

blocks.en: We reported multiple performance metrics as no single measure is universally suited for all evaluation objectives ( Stehman, 1997 ) . Our primary metric was the precision-recall area under the curve (PR-AUC), complemented by the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC-AUC), the overlap coefficient, precision, recall and F1. PR-AUC, calculated as the average precision, summarises the trade-off between precision (the proportion of OGF predictions that were true OGF parcels) and recall (the proportion of true OGF parcels predicted as OGF). It ranges from the OGF prevalence rate (0.21) for a no-skill classifier to 1 for a perfect classifier. We selected PR-AUC as our primary metric because it is threshold-free, not inflated by the non-OGF majority class, and sensitive to the performance of the minority OGF class.
blocks.zh: 我们报告了多项业绩衡量标准,因为没有一个单一衡量标准普遍适合所有评价目标(Stehman,1997年)。 我们的主要衡量标准是曲线下的精准调值区(PR-AUC),辅之以接收器操作特征曲线下的面积(ROC-AUC),重叠系数,精准度,召回率和F1. PR-AUC,以平均精度计算,概括精准度(OGF预测数中真实的OGF数据包的比例)和召回率(真实的OGF数据包预测数的比例)之间的权衡. 它从无技能分类器的OGF流行率(0.21)到完美分类器的1. 我们选择PR-AUC作为我们的首要衡量标准,因为它是无门槛的,而不是被非OGF多数阶层夸大,并且对少数OGF阶层的表现敏感.

blocks.en: ROC-AUC quantifies the probability that a randomly selected OGF parcel scores higher than a randomly selected non-OGF parcel and ranges from 0.5 for a no-skill classifier to 1 for a perfect classifier. Its advantage is that it is independent of prevalence, improving comparability across studies; however, it can appear optimistic under class imbalance ( Saito & Rehmsmeier, 2015 ) , such as that present in our study.
blocks.zh: ROC-AUC将随机选择的OGF包裹得分高于随机选择的非OGF包裹的概率量化,从无技能分类器的0.5到完美分类器的1不等. 它的优点是它独立于流行性,提高了不同研究的可比性;然而,在阶级失衡(Saito & Rehmsmeier,2015年)下,它可以显得乐观,比如我们的研究中的内容.

blocks.en: The overlap coefficient quantifies the area shared by two normalised histograms of the predicted scores for OGF and non-OGF reference parcels, ranging from 0 for perfectly separated classes to 1 for identical class distributions ( Pastore & Calcagnì, 2019 ) . It is threshold-free and prevalence-insensitive, but does not capture ranking performance.
blocks.zh: 重叠系数将OGF和非OGF参考包的预测分数的两个正常直方图所共享的区域量化,从完全分离类的0到相同类的1(Pastore & Calcagnì, 2019). 它无门槛和流行性不敏感,但不能捕捉排名性能.

blocks.en: Precision, recall and F1 (the harmonic mean of precision and recall) were calculated at a 0.5 majority-area threshold for the existing studies (Fig. S2 ). For our models, each parcel was classified as OGF or non-OGF using the threshold that maximised F1 on its own fold’s pooled inner-fold (see Section 2.7 ) predictions; precision, recall and F1 were then calculated from the pooled held-out binary predictions. This ensured that the threshold used to assess each parcel was never fitted to that same parcel.
blocks.zh: 精确、召回和F1(精确和召回的谐调平均值)是按现有研究(图S2)0.5多数区阈值计算的。 对我们的模型来说,每个包裹被归类为OGF或非OGF,其阈值是将F1在自己折叠的集合内叠(见第2.7节)预测中最大化;精度、召回和F1随后从集合的搁置二进制预测中计算出来。 这确保了用于评估每件包裹的阈值从未与同一包裹相符。

blocks.en: 2.4. Evaluation against existing studies
blocks.zh: 2.4. 对照现有研究进行评价

blocks.en: We evaluated four existing studies against our reference labels: two derived from machine learning models ( Sabatini, 2020 ; Munteanu et al., 2022 , hereafter ‘model-based’ studies) and two derived from expert inspection and thresholding ( Kathmann et al., 2017 ; Schickhofer & Schwarz, 2019 , hereafter ‘rule-based’ studies). They map different combinations of primary, old-growth and high-conservation-value forests; however, our OGF labels (virgin and quasi-virgin forests) and non-OGF labels (stands ≤ \leq 80 years) represent parcels that these definitions should reasonably be expected to include and exclude, respectively. Nonetheless, each study was designed for a different objective, and our evaluation was limited to their parcel-level predictions within the AOI.
blocks.zh: 我们对照我们的参考标签评价了现有的四项研究:两项研究来自机器学习模型(Sabatini,2020年;Munteanu等人,2022年,以下简称 " 模型研究 " )和两项研究来自专家检查和阈值(Kathmann等人,2017年;Schickhofer & Schwarz,2019年,以下简称 " 规则研究 " )。 它们绘制了原始、旧生长和高养护价值森林的不同组合图;然而,我们的OGF标签(Virgin和准Virgin森林)和非OGF标签(Stands \\leq 80年)代表了这些定义应分别合理预期包括和排除的包裹。 尽管如此,每一项研究都是为了不同的目标而设计的,我们的评价仅限于在澳大利亚石油工业组织内部的包裹级预测。

blocks.en: Sabatini (2020) provides a Europe-wide binary (0/1) 250 m primary forest raster combining documented forests from the European Primary Forest Database (EPFD) v1.0 ( Sabatini et al., 2018 ) with additional forests modelled using a boosted regression tree trained on geospatial proxies such as climate and topography, and thresholded to fill the shortfall between national estimates of undisturbed forests and the EPFD ( Sabatini et al., 2020 ) . Munteanu et al. (2022) provide a 30 m four-class high-conservation-value forest (HCVF) raster from maximum entropy models trained on optical, radar and geospatial proxy data, from which we assigned their two structurally complex classes, prime and at-risk HCVF, as OGF. Kathmann et al. (2017) provide a vector layer of primary and old-growth forest polygons for the Romanian Carpathians from vegetation index thresholding, visual interpretation and rule-based exclusions. Schickhofer & Schwarz (2019) provide a vector layer of potential primary and old-growth forest polygons for Romania from visual interpretation of very-high-resolution optical imagery against naturalness criteria calibrated with field observations; of the four, it is the most comprehensive expert inventory of primary and old-growth forests covering our AOI. The two model-based studies, Sabatini (2020) ; Munteanu et al. (2022) , also publish continuous probability surfaces (0–1) of primary and forest structural complexity, respectively.
blocks.zh: 萨巴蒂尼(2020年)提供了全欧洲二进制(0/1)250米原始森林光栅,将欧洲原始森林数据库(EPFD)v1.0(Sabatini等人,2018年)的有记录的森林结合起来,并使用在气候和地形等地理空间代位素方面受过培训的增强回归树进行模型建设,其阈值用于填补国家未扰动森林估计数与EPFD之间的缺口(Sabatini等人,2020年)。 Munteanu 等人 (英语). (2022年)提供30米四级高保值森林(HCVF)光学,雷达和地理空间代用数据训练的来自最大演算模型的光圈光栅,从中我们分配了他们两个结构复杂的班级,质地和风险HCVF作为OGF. Kathmann等人(2017年)为罗马尼亚喀尔巴阡山脉提供了原始和古老的森林多边形的矢量层,它们来自植被指数阈值、视觉解释和基于规则的排除。 Schickhofer & Schwarz(2019年)为罗马尼亚提供了潜在原始森林和旧生长森林多边形的矢量层,从对非常高分辨率光学图像的直观判读,参照自然标准与实地观测进行校准;在四种中,它是涵盖我国AOI的原始森林和旧生长森林最全面的专家清单。 两项基于模型的研究,即Sabatini(2020年);Munteanu等人(2022年),也分别公布了初级和森林结构复杂性的连续概率表(0-1)。

blocks.en: We applied a common evaluation method across studies. The original rasters and rasterised vectors were reprojected onto the common reference grid, and nearest-neighbour resampling was applied to the raster outputs to preserve the authors’ predictions. For both the binary and continuous outputs, we calculated per-study parcel-level OGF scores from the unweighted mean of the pixel-level predictions (0, 1 or 0–1) fully enclosed by that parcel (see Section 2.3 ). We calculated PR-AUC, ROC-AUC, precision, recall and F1 for the binary outputs, and we additionally calculated the overlap coefficient and associated histograms for the continuous outputs.
blocks.zh: 我们在整个研究中采用了一种共同的评价方法。 最初的光栅和光栅矢量被重新投射到共同的参考网格上,最近邻居的重新取样被应用于光栅输出,以保存作者的预测。 就二进制和连续产出而言,我们从该包裹(见第2.3节)完全封装的未加权像素级预测平均值(0、1或0-1)中计算出每研究包裹一级的OGF分数。 我们计算了二进制产出的PR-AUC、ROC-AUC、精度、召回和F1,我们还计算了连续产出的重叠系数和相关直方图。

blocks.en: 2.5. Feature sets and model architectures
blocks.zh: 2.5. 地物和模型建筑

blocks.en: We constructed five feature sets to evaluate the extent to which freely available EO data contain information predictive of old-growth forests, beyond a topographic and access baseline (Fig. 1 c). Following Ploton et al. (2020) , we defined a coordinate-only control feature set, using the easting and northing of pixels as sole predictors. A baseline feature set was constructed from six geospatial layers: elevation, slope, heat load index, and distance to paved roads, unpaved roads and footpaths (Table 2 a–d). We then constructed three EO-based feature sets to evaluate their incremental and relative contribution: baseline + conventional EO , a 28-band stack comprising baseline plus annual median Sentinel-1/2 composites and vegetation index temporal dynamics (Table 2 e–f); baseline + AlphaEarth , a 70-band stack comprising baseline plus AlphaEarth embeddings (Table 2 g); and baseline + TESSERA , a 134-band stack comprising baseline plus TESSERA v2 embeddings (hereafter TESSERA; Table 2 h). We intentionally used analysis-ready products for the conventional EO feature set to ensure that the acquisition effort was comparable to the GFM embeddings. A shared no-data pixel mask was applied to all layers to ensure each feature set covered all pixels included in the analysis.
blocks.zh: 我们建造了五套功能,评价自由获取的地球轨道数据包含的旧生长森林预测信息超出地形和获取基线的程度(图1c)。 继Ploton等人(2020年)之后,我们定义了一个只使用坐标的控制特性集,使用像素的东向和北向作为唯一的预测器. 从6个地理空间层构建了一套基线特征:高程、坡度、热负荷指数,以及通往铺设道路、未铺设道路和人行道的距离(表2a-d)。 然后,我们建造了三套基于EO的特征集,以评估其增量和相对贡献:基线+常规EO,一个由基线加年度中位数Sentinel-1/2复合材料和植被指数时间动态组成的28波段堆叠(表2e-f);基线+AlphaEarth,由基线加AlphaEarth嵌入物组成的70波段堆叠(表2g);基线+TESERA,由基线加TESERA v2嵌入物组成的134波段堆叠(下称TESSERA;表2h)。 我们有意将分析准备的产品用于常规的EO特性,以确保采购工作与GFM嵌入法相似。 对所有层都应用了共享的无数据像素掩码,以确保每个特性集覆盖分析中包含的所有像素.

blocks.en: To determine whether introducing spatial context affected model performance, we defined four model architectures: XGBoost ( Chen & Guestrin, 2016 ) with a single-pixel input and CNNs with 3 × 3 3\times 3 -, 5 × 5 5\times 5 - and 7 × 7 7\times 7 -pixel receptive fields (Fig. 1 d). All models output single-pixel old-growth scores (0–1), which were aggregated to parcel-level scores as described in Section 2.3 . We evaluated the performance of the four architectures against each of the five feature sets, resulting in 20 configurations.
blocks.zh: 为了确定引入空间背景是否影响模型性能,我们定义了四个模型架构: XGBoost (Chen & Guestrin, 2016) 单像素输入和CNN 3×3 3\times 3 -,5×5 5\times 5 -和 7×7 7\times 7 - 像素可接受字段(图1 d). 所有模型都输出单像素的旧增长分数(0-1),如第2.3节所述,这些分数被合并为包裹级分数。 我们对照五套功能中的每一套,评价了这四套建筑的性能,最终形成了20套配置.

blocks.en: 2.6. Spatial autocorrelation
blocks.zh: 2.6. 空间自动化

blocks.en: We quantified the extent and magnitude of spatial autocorrelation in our reference labels and predictors to inform the fold separation and train-test buffers applied during cross-validation (Section 2.7 ). Empirical semivariograms ( Matheron, 1963 ) were calculated at 1 km lag bins to a maximum lag of 40 km (approximately half the maximum extent of the AOI, following Garrigues et al., 2006 ), and exponential, Gaussian and spherical models were fitted to obtain three estimates of the effective range. Fitted ranges at or above 90% of the maximum lag, or below the 1 km lag bin width, were reported as unresolved. Moran’s I I ( Moran, 1950 ) was evaluated at 5, 10, 15 and 20 km distance bands; we report the 10 km band here and the others in Table S2 .
blocks.zh: 我们在参考标签和预测器中量化了空间自动连接的程度和规模,以告知交叉验证期间使用的折叠分离和列车测试缓冲(第2.7节)。 经验半变量图(Matheron,1963年)在1公里的后置箱中计算到最大后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后置后 据报告,最大滞后幅度的90%以上或低于1公里滞后的本宽度,尚未解决。 Moran的I(Moran,1950年)被评为5、10、15和20公里;我们在这里报告10公里的波段,其他的则在表S2中报告。

blocks.en: Both the reference labels and predictors showed spatial dependence at kilometre scales (Fig. 2 ). The reference labels had a semivariogram range of 6.6–6.7 km and Moran’s I I of 0.10 at 10 km. The predictors with the longest semivariogram range were elevation (16.4–21.2 km), slope (19.4–21.0 km) and distance to paved road (17.4–22.0 km), with Moran’s I I correspondingly high for elevation and distance to paved road (0.34 and 0.54, respectively). Most conventional EO predictors exhibited ranges up to approximately 10 km, except for VPP seasonal productivity and start-of-season date, whose spatial ranges were unresolved. The AlphaEarth and TESSERA embeddings were comparable to each other, with median per-dimension ranges (median of the resolved model fits) of 9.4 km (interquartile range (IQR) 5.9–15.6 km) and 10.5 km (IQR 6.8–19.8 km), and median Moran’s I I of 0.10 (IQR 0.06–0.16) and 0.10 (IQR 0.06–0.15), respectively.

blocks.en: 2.7. Spatially blocked nested cross-validation
blocks.zh: 2.7. 空间屏蔽的巢穴交叉验证

blocks.en: We assigned the reference labels to six spatially blocked folds (Fig. 1 b) using a rotating 3 × 2 3\times 2 grid-partitioning algorithm that minimised the summed squared deviation of each fold’s total and OGF areas from an equal split, with an enforced ± \pm 25% tolerance (Fig. S3 ). Adjacent parcels were merged into connected components before fold assignment to ensure touching parcels were not split across folds. The resulting folds had an OGF prevalence of 14–29% and a median cross-fold distance between parcels of 22–34 km.
blocks.zh: 我们使用旋转 3× 2 3\时的 2 个网格分割算法,将每个网格的总面积和 OGF 区域的总平方偏差最小化,从一个平方分中,强制 ±\pm 25% 的容忍度(图 S3),为六个空间屏蔽的折叠(图 1 b)指定了参考标签。 相邻的包裹在折叠分配前被合并为连接的组件,以确保触摸的包裹不会在折叠间分割. 由此产生的折叠值的OGF普及率为14-29%,包裹之间的中位跨倍距离为22-34公里。

blocks.en: Model performance was evaluated for the 20 feature-set/model-architecture configurations using nested cross-validation across the six spatially blocked folds (Algorithm 1). For each configuration, an outer loop held out each fold in turn as a test set, and the remaining five folds were used in an inner cross-validation loop to tune the hyperparameters with Optuna, a Bayesian optimisation framework ( Akiba et al., 2019 ) , over T = 50 T=50 trials for XGBoost and T = 30 T=30 trials for the more costly CNNs. Hyperparameter tuning had a moderate impact on performance, with the selected trial achieving a median improvement in parcel PR-AUC of 0.02 over the median trial, and 0.13 (XGBoost) and 0.05 (CNN) over the worst trial (Table S4 ). This nested approach ensured that the data used to train and tune a model were never used to estimate its performance. We report out-of-fold (OOF) performance as the primary metric, calculated from the aggregated held-out predictions for all six folds. Confidence intervals (CIs) were obtained from the 2.5 th {}^{\text{th}} –97.5 th {}^{\text{th}} percentiles (95% CIs) of a bootstrap over 20 area-balanced spatial blocks (Fig. S4 ), resampled with replacement over 5,000 replicates. Contrasts between feature sets and model architectures were calculated as paired differences on these same replicates and reported with their CIs and a two-sided bootstrap p p -value, which was equal to twice the smaller of the proportions of replicates in which the difference was at or below, or at or above, zero ( Davison & Hinkley, 1997 ) .
blocks.zh: 对20个特征集/模型-建筑构型的模型性能进行了评价,使用了覆盖6个空间屏蔽折叠的嵌套交叉验证(算法1). 对于每个配置,一个外环依次将每个折叠作为测试集,其余五个折叠被用在内交叉验证循环来调节超参数与Optuna,一个贝叶斯优化框架(Akiba等人,2019年),T=50 T=50测试XGBoost,T=30测试成本较高的CNN. 超参数调试对性能有中度影响,选定的试验使包裹PR-AUC的中位数比试验中位数提高0.02,比试验中位数提高0.13(XGBoost)和0.05(CNN),比试验中位数提高(表S4)。 这种嵌套方法确保用于训练和调制模型的数据从未用于估计其性能. 我们报告,从所有六个折叠体的累积预言中计算出双倍(OOF)性能作为主要衡量标准。 信任间隔(CI)来自20个区域均衡空间块(图S4)的靴子的2.5th QQText{th{th}-97.5th text{th}百分位数(95%CIS),用5000多个复制件的替换方式重新复制。 特性集与模型结构之间的对比被计算为在这些相同的复制品上的配对差异,并与它们的CI和双面靴子p-值报告,后者等于复制品中差异在零或低于零或高于零的比例的两倍(Davison & Hinkley,1997年)。

blocks.en: To determine whether residual cross-fold parcel proximity affected performance estimates, we adapted the buffered approach of Ploton et al. (2020) to our nested cross-validation design. Training parcels within a buffered distance d d of the held-out test fold were excluded, and the model was refitted with the hyperparameters already selected for that fold. The inner-loop hyperparameter search was flat near its optimum and therefore unlikely to bias the reported comparisons (Table S4 ). All 20 model configurations were evaluated at d ∈ { 0 , 10 , 20 } ​ km d\in\{0,10,20\}\,\mathrm{km} . To separate the effects of training data loss from spatial leakage, the XGBoost models were additionally swept at d ∈ { 0 , 1 , … , 30 } ​ km d\in\{0,1,\ldots,30\}\,\mathrm{km} , alongside a parcel-matched control at each distance, in which the same number of training parcels was removed randomly rather than by proximity.
blocks.zh: 为了确定残余的交叉包裹邻近是否影响性能估计,我们将Ploton等人(2020年)的缓冲方法调整为巢式交叉验证设计. 排除了搁置试验折叠物中缓冲距离d的训练包,并用已经为该折叠物选定的超参数重排模型。 内径超参数搜索非常平整,接近最佳,因此不可能偏向所报告的比较(表S4)。 所有20个模型配置在 d {{0, 10, 20} km d\in} 0, 10, 20}\ mathrm{ km} 得到评价 。 为了区分培训数据丢失和空间渗漏的影响,XGBooost模型在d {{0, 1, ..., 30} km d\in {0, 1,\ ldots, 30}}\ mathrm{km} 被额外扫射,同时在每个距离上有一个包裹匹配的控制,其中同样数量的培训包裹被随机地而不是靠近地去掉.

blocks.en: Four sensitivity analyses were conducted to assess: robustness to fold composition (leave-one-fold-out, Tables S14 and S15 ); training-pixel sampling (unweighted, inverse-prevalence and stratification, Table S5 ); model stochasticity (five training seeds, Tables S16 and S17 ); and bootstrap block count (6–30 blocks, Table S3 ), none of which changed the conclusions.
blocks.zh: 进行了4次敏感性分析,以评估:折叠成份的稳健性(1倍径,表S14和S15);培训像素取样(不加权、反照率和分层,表S5);模型结构性(5个训练种子,表S16和S17);靴状块计数(6至30个块,表S3),没有改变结论。

blocks.en: 2.8. Mapping

We retrained our best-performing model on all reference labels to produce wall-to-wall 10 m resolution rasters with calibrated old-growth probability (0–1) and binary classification (0/1) pixels, and a vector with calibrated probability and binary attributes for 15,443 forest parcels (72 parcels contained no pixel centre and were not classified, see Section S2.1 ). The probability estimates were obtained using separate pixel- and parcel-level Platt-scaling models, each fitted to the raw out-of-fold old-growth scores and corresponding reference labels ( Platt, 2000 ) , on which the calibration errors were also calculated.
blocks.zh: 我们在所有参考标签上重新培训了最佳的模型,以产生10米分辨率的壁对壁光栅,具有校准的老生长概率(0-1)和二进制分类(0/1)像素,以及15 443个森林包裹具有校准概率和二进制属性的矢量(72个包裹没有像素中心,没有分类,见S2.1节)。 概率估计是使用单独的像素级和包裹级的Platt级模型获得的,每个模型都与原始的老生长分数和相应的参考标签(Platt,2000年)相匹配,其中计算了校准错误。

blocks.en: A point estimate of the old-growth forest extent within the AOI was calculated as the area of the parcels with an old-growth score exceeding the F1-maximising threshold on the calibrated out-of-fold predictions. Uncertainty in the mapped old-growth area was estimated using a retraining 20-spatial-block bootstrap across 1,000 replicates, resampled with replacement. Wall-to-wall prediction was re-run across the AOI for each replicate, and the old-growth extent was calculated at the parcel level using the same fixed threshold as the point estimate.
blocks.zh: 对AOI内部的老生长森林面积的点估计被计算为老生长分数超过经校准的外延预测的F1-最大阈值的地块面积. 利用再培训20个空间区块的靴子,在1 000个复制品上重新加印,估计了已绘制地图的老种植区的不确定性。 墙对墙的预测在每次复制时都经过AOI的重新运行,旧生长范围是用与点估计相同的固定阈值在包裹水平上计算出来的.

blocks.en: 2.9. Determination of area of applicability
blocks.zh: 2.9. 确定适用范围

blocks.en: To assess the extent to which our model could be applied beyond the AOI, we calculated its area of applicability (AOA) within the Carpathian Mountain range using the method of Meyer & Pebesma (2021) . The AOA delineates the area for which predictor features resemble a model’s training data, and therefore where cross-validated performance can be reasonably expected to apply. Using a 100 m grid in EPSG:3035, we calculated a dissimilarity index (DI) for all pixels within the Carpathian Mountains. The DI is the distance in feature space to the nearest training pixel, with predictors mean-standardised and weighted by importance (XGBoost gain), and normalised by the mean pairwise distance among training pixels. The AOA comprises pixels whose DI does not exceed the largest cross-validated training DI, excluding outliers (i.e. Q 3 + 1.5 × IQR Q_{3}+1.5\times\mathrm{IQR} , the box plot upper whisker). Each training pixel’s DI is calculated relative to the nearest training pixel outside its own fold. A polygon delineating the Carpathian Mountains was obtained from the European Environment Agency geospatial data catalogue ( EEA, 2008 ) , and forest extent was extracted from cells in the ESA WorldCover 2020 raster with a tree-cover fraction ≥ \geq 0.5 ( Zanaga et al., 2021 ) , as CORINE Land Cover polygons do not cover Ukraine.
blocks.zh: 为了评估我们的模型在多大程度上可以应用到AOI之外,我们使用Meyer & Pebesma(2021年)的方法计算了它在喀尔巴阡山脉范围内的适用范围(AOA). AOA划定了预测器特征类似于模型培训数据的领域,因此可以合理地预期可适用交叉核实的性能。 使用EPSG 30:35的100米网格计算出喀尔巴阡山脉内所有像素的异构指数(DI). DI是特征空间与最接近的训练像素的距离,预测器为平均标准,按重要性加权(XGBoost增益),按训练像素之间的平均对比距离正常化. AOA由像素组成,其DI不超过最大的交叉验证的训练 DI,不包括输出者(即Q 3 + 1.5 × IQR → 3 → 1.5\times\mathrm{IQR},盒式图案的上剃须). 每个训练像素的DI是相对于自己折叠之外最近的训练像素计算的. 从欧洲环境署地理空间数据目录(欧洲环境局,2008年)中获取了划分喀尔巴阡山脉的多边形,从欧空局2020年世界覆盖光栅中的细胞中提取了森林范围,树覆盖部分为 \\ geq 0.5(Zanaga等人,2021年),因为CORINE土地覆盖多边形不覆盖乌克兰。

blocks.en: The four existing studies differed threefold in the mapped extent of primary, old-growth and high-conservation-value forest across the AOI (Table 3 ). Estimates ranged from 20,865 ha (13.7% of the forested AOI) for Sabatini (2020) to 64,146 ha (42.1%) for Kathmann et al. (2017) . Native pixel-level area estimates differed from the parcel-level extents by less than 1% for all products except Sabatini (2020) , which differed by + + 13.3% (2,779 ha, Table S19 ).
blocks.zh: 现有四项研究在绘制全澳大利亚森林组织原始森林、老林和高保护价值森林的地图方面有三重不同(表3)。 估计萨巴蒂尼(2020年)的面积为20,865公顷(占森林中AOI的13.7%),Kathmann等人(2017年)的面积为64,146公顷(42.1%)。 除萨巴蒂尼(2020年)外,所有产品的原生像素水平面积估计值与地块水平值相差不到1%,后者的比值为+13.3%(2,779公顷,表S19)。

blocks.en: Agreement with our OGF/non-OGF reference labels varied substantially across the four studies; however, the ordering of studies was stable whether using PR-AUC, ROC-AUC or F1 (Table 3 ). For the two model-based studies, the ROC-AUC on our reference labels reproduced the authors’ published values almost exactly: 0.68 against 0.65 for Sabatini (2020) (reported in Sabatini et al., 2020 ) and 0.86, unchanged, for Munteanu et al. (2022) . Label agreement was highest for Schickhofer & Schwarz (2019) , a field-calibrated rule-based map. With a PR-AUC of 0.65, it recovered 90% of our OGF reference parcels with 64% precision. Agreement was lowest for Sabatini (2020) , a Europe-wide model-based map derived from geospatial proxies, which achieved a PR-AUC of 0.35 against the 0.21 no-skill floor. This ordering was consistent across different landscapes within the AOI, with Schickhofer & Schwarz (2019) ranking highest and Sabatini (2020) lowest across forest type, altitude and slope strata (Fig. 3 , Table S20 ). Nominal performance was weakest at the highest altitudes (1,406–1,892 m) for all studies. Rule-based approaches did not universally achieve higher agreement. The model-based Munteanu et al. (2022) exceeded the rule-based Kathmann et al. (2017) by 0.13 PR-AUC, with greater precision (51% versus 43%) for a comparable recall (76% versus 77%).
blocks.zh: 在四项研究中,与我们的OGF/非OGF参考标签达成的协议大不相同;然而,无论是使用PR-AUC、ROC-AUC还是F1,研究的顺序都是稳定的(表3)。 对于两个模型研究,我们参考标签上的ROC-AUC几乎完全照搬了作者公布的数值:Sabatini(2020年)为0.68对0.65(Sabatini等人报告,2020年),Munteanu等人(2022年)为0.86。 标签协议对Schickhofer & Schwarz(2019年)来说是最高的,这是一份实地校准的规则地图. PR-AUC为0.65,它以64%的精度回收了90%的OGF参考包. Sabatini协议最低(2020年),这是一张来自地理空间代理的全欧洲模型地图,实现了0.35的PR-AUC对0.21的无技能底. AOI内部不同地貌的这种顺序一致,Schickhofer & Schwarz(2019年)在森林类型、海拔和山坡层排名最高,Sabatini(2020年)在排名最低(图3,表S20)。 在所有研究中,在最高海拔(1 406-1 892米)时,名义性能最弱。 以规则为基础的办法并没有普遍取得更高的一致。 基于模型的Munteanu等人(2022年)比基于规则的Kathmann等人(2017年)多出0.13 PR-AUC,对于类似的召回(76%对77%)更精确(51%对43%).

blocks.en: Analysis of the two model-based studies’ continuous probability surfaces showed near-complete overlap in the OGF and non-OGF parcel score distributions for Sabatini (2020) (0.80 overlap coefficient), and partial separation for Munteanu et al. (2022) (0.44), indicating limited discrimination between the two classes. The corresponding histograms showed that the distribution overlap was caused by non-OGF parcels receiving high-confidence OGF scores (Fig. S5 ).
blocks.zh: 对两项模型研究的连续概率表面的分析显示,萨巴蒂尼的OGF和非OGF包裹分数分布(2020年)几乎完全重叠(0.80重叠系数),Munteanu等人的部分分离(2022年)(0.44),表明这两个类别之间的差别有限。 相应的直方图显示,分配重叠是由非OGF包裹获得高自信OGF分数(图S5)造成的.

blocks.en: 3.2. Contribution of Earth observation feature sets
blocks.zh: 3.2. 地球观测特征集的贡献

blocks.en: All EO-derived feature sets contained information predictive of old-growth forests beyond topographic and access covariates. Adding conventional EO, AlphaEarth embeddings or TESSERA embeddings to the baseline feature set increased PR-AUC by 0.22–0.29 without train-test buffering, with all 95% CIs above zero. This improvement persisted when training parcels within 10 km and 20 km of the held-out test folds were excluded, with PR-AUC gains ranging from 0.21 to 0.25 [95% CIs 0.15 to 0.34] under a 10 km buffer (Fig. 4 e, Tables S7 and S8 ).
blocks.zh: 所有EO衍生的特征集都包含对地形和接触共变物以外的老森林的预测信息。 将常规EO,AlphaEarth嵌入或TESSERA嵌入到基线特性中,将PR-AUC增加了0.22-0.29,不进行列车测试缓冲,所有95%的CI均高于零. 在10公里缓冲器(图4 e,表S7和S8)下排除了10公里和20公里范围内的培训包,而PR-AUC的收益从0.21到0.25[95%CIS 0.15到0.34]不等,这种改进仍在继续。

blocks.en: The best-performing configuration was XGBoost trained on the baseline + TESSERA feature set with a 0 km buffer, which achieved a PR-AUC of 0.84 [95% CI 0.79–0.88] (Fig. 4 a). This configuration performed consistently across metrics (ROC-AUC 0.95 [0.94–0.97]; F1 0.77 [0.71–0.81], Table S7 ) and forest type, altitude and slope strata (Fig. 3 ). Per-fold performance is reported in Tables S11 , S12 and S13 .
blocks.zh: 表现最好的配置是XGBoost在基线+TESSERA特性设定上接受了0公里缓冲器的培训,实现了0.84[95%CI 0.79-0.88]的PR-AUC(图4a)。 这种配置在各种指标(ROC-AUC 0.95 [0.94-0.97];F1 0.77 [0.71-0.81],表S7)和森林类型、海拔和山坡层(图3)之间一致进行。 表S11、S12和S13分别报告了每份业绩。

blocks.en: TESSERA’s advantage over conventional EO and AlphaEarth was statistically significant without a train-test buffer, with respective differences in PR-AUC of + + 0.08 [95% CI 0.05–0.11; p < 0.001 p<0.001 ] and + + 0.08 [0.04–0.12; p < 0.001 p<0.001 ] (positive in 6/6 folds). However, TESSERA’s advantage was not statistically significant at a 10 km buffer, with conventional EO and AlphaEarth contrasts of + + 0.04 [ − - 0.01 to 0.11; p = 0.13 p=0.13 ] (positive in 5/6 folds) and + + 0.03 [ − - 0.04 to 0.10; p = 0.45 p=0.45 ] (positive in 4/6 folds), respectively, although the intervals remain compatible with an advantage as large as the unbuffered one (Fig. 4 f, Table S9 ).
blocks.zh: TESERA在常规EO和AlphaEarth上的优势在统计学上是显著的,没有火车测试缓冲器,在PR-AUC中各自的差异分别为+ + 0.08 [95% CI 0.05-0.11;p < 0.001 p < 0.001]和+ + 0.08 [0.04–0.12;p < 0.001 p < 0.001] (正面为6/6折叠)。 然而,TESSERA的优势在统计学上在10公里缓冲线上并不显著,传统的EO和AlphaEarth对比值分别为+ + 0.04 [− - 0.01至0.11;p = 0.13 p= 0.13] (正值为5/6折叠)和+ + 0.03 [− 0.04至0.10;p = 04.5] (正值为4/6折叠),尽管间隔值仍然与未缓冲线的大小优势(图4f,表S9)相容。

blocks.en: Residual spatial autocorrelation for the XGBoost configurations ranged from 4.5 to 6.5 km across the feature sets, with Moran’s I I ≤ \leq 0.07 at the 10 km band (Table S18 ). These ranges were at or below those of the labels and EO predictors, and well below those of the baseline predictors, suggesting the model did not learn their long-range ( ≥ \geq 10 km) spatial structure. This residual spatial autocorrelation range was corroborated by a train-test buffer sweep from 0 to 30 km, which for all feature sets showed a steady fall in the PR-AUC relative to the parcel-matched control before plateauing at a buffer of 8–10 km (Fig. 5 ). This range also corresponded with the coordinate-only control reaching the 0.21 PR-AUC no-skill floor (Figs. 4 a and S7 ), which, in addition to the collapse in remaining training data at buffer distances ≥ \geq 16 km, informed our choice of 10 km for the spatially buffered performance reported in Fig. 4 .

blocks.en: For the parcel-matched control, in which parcels were removed at random rather than by proximity under spatially blocked cross-validation, a 50% fall in training data reduced PR-AUC by less than 0.04 for the four feature sets (excluding the coordinate-only control), with OGF prevalence unchanged at 21% (Figs. S6 and S7 ). This indicated that the quantity of training labels was not a binding constraint.
blocks.zh: 对于包裹匹配控制,在空间屏蔽的交叉验证下,包裹被随机而不是近距离移除,对于这四套功能(不包括坐标控制),培训数据下降50%后PR-AUC减少0.04以下,OGF流行率不变,为21%(图S6和S7)。 这表明,培训标签的数量不是有约束力的限制。

blocks.en: XGBoost gain analysis showed that baseline predictors remained important across feature sets, with distance to unpaved road contributing more than any other individual feature in every stack (Fig. 6 ). Under baseline + conventional EO , the vegetation indices were the largest group, with NDVI p10, p50 and p90 contributing more than the six annual median reflectance bands combined. The aggregate AlphaEarth and TESSERA embeddings accounted for 0.82 and 0.87 of the gain, respectively; however, the individual embeddings have no direct physical interpretation. Although AlphaEarth was trained on topographic and land-cover inputs, and therefore baseline + AlphaEarth partially double-counted terrain, the baseline features still ranked higher when combined with AlphaEarth than with TESSERA.
blocks.zh: XGBooost增益分析显示,基线预测器在各种特征集中仍然很重要,与未铺设道路的距离比每一堆中的任何其他单个特征贡献更大(图6)。 在基线+常规EO下,植被指数是最大的组别,NDVI p10,p50和p90的贡献大于6个年中反射波段的总和. 阿尔法地球嵌入物和TESSERA嵌入物分别占收益的0.82和0.87;然而,单个嵌入物没有直接的物理解释. 虽然AlphaEarth接受了地形和土地覆盖投入方面的培训,因此基线+AlphaEarth部分重复计算地形,但基线特征与AlphaEarth结合时的排名仍然高于TESSERA。

blocks.en: 3.3. Contribution of spatial context
blocks.zh: 3.3. 空间环境的贡献

blocks.en: Introducing spatial context through a CNN model architecture did not improve parcel-level performance for any feature set (Fig. 4 g, Table S10 ). At a 0 km train-test buffer, the performance of the CNN was lower for all feature sets excluding baseline , with the best-performing models differing from XGBoost PR-AUC by − - 0.05 [95% CI − - 0.09 to − - 0.01; p = 0.008 p=0.008 ] ( baseline + conventional EO , 5 × 5 5\times 5 ), − - 0.07 [ − - 0.10 to − - 0.03; p < 0.001 p<0.001 ] ( baseline + AlphaEarth , 3 × 3 3\times 3 ) and − - 0.06 [ − - 0.09 to − - 0.03; p < 0.001 p<0.001 ] ( baseline + TESSERA , 3 × 3 3\times 3 ). While the 5 × 5 5\times 5 CNN improved the PR-AUC point estimate by 0.02 on the baseline feature set, the 95% confidence intervals crossed zero. Point PR-AUC performance degraded with receptive-field size for both GFMs. The performance penalty for the CNN models was less conclusive when evaluated at the pixel level, with all baseline and two baseline + AlphaEarth configurations showing a moderate improvement of up to 0.03 in PR-AUC point estimates (Table S6 ), suggesting the CNN architecture interacted negatively with parcel aggregation.

blocks.en: 3.4. Mapping old-growth in the Făgăraş Mountains
blocks.zh: 3.4. 绘制Făgăraş山脉的老生长图

blocks.en: Using the XGBoost model trained on baseline + TESSERA , we classified 55,025 ha [39,124–62,515 ha] as candidate old-growth forests within the AOI, covering 36.1% [25.7–41.0%] of the forested landscape (Fig. S8 ). This model was used because it had the highest performance with a 0 km buffer, the regime that best matches interpolation within the AOI where training and target parcels are interspersed rather than spatially separated. Of the 4,294 forest parcels classified as OGF, 2,031 were coniferous (19,195 ha, 12.6% of the forested AOI), 1,880 mixed (29,918 ha, 19.6% of the forested AOI) and 352 broadleaf (5,710 ha, 3.7% of the forested AOI), with the remaining 31 parcels (202 ha) unclassified by CORINE Land Cover ( CLMS, 2020 ) . The calibrated pixel-level raster (Fig. 1 e) and forest parcels vector (Fig. 1 f) had in-sample expected calibration errors (ECE) of 0.5% and 2.0%, and maximum calibration errors (MCE) of 1.9% and 13.6%, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们使用在基线+TESSERA上训练的XGBoost模型,将55,025公顷[39,124–62,515公顷]划为AOI范围内的候选老林,覆盖森林景观的36.1%[25.7–41.0%](图S8). 这一模型之所以使用,是因为其性能最高,缓冲为0公里,这种制度最能匹配阿拉伯工业化组织内部的内插,在那里,培训和目标包裹相互交叉,而不是在空间上分开。 在被归类为OGF的4,294个森林地块中,2,031个是圆叶(19,195公顷,12.6%为森林的AOI)、1,880个混血(29,918公顷,19.6%为森林的AOI)和352个阔叶(5,710公顷,3.7%为森林的AOI),其余31个地块(202公顷)由CORINE土地覆盖(CLMS,2020年)未分类。 校准的像素级光栅(图1 e)和森林包裹矢量(图1 f)分别存在0.5%和2.0%的模拟预期校准差(ECE)和1.9%和13.6%的最大校准误差(MCE).

blocks.en: Of the four existing studies, our model’s predictions most closely aligned with Schickhofer & Schwarz (2019) , a field-calibrated expert interpretation of very-high-resolution imagery, which assigns the same OGF/non-OGF class to 83% of parcels within the AOI (Fig. S9 ). Excluding parcels with a reference label, which share partial provenance with Schickhofer & Schwarz (2019) via a 2001–2005 inventory ( Veen et al., 2010 ) , agreement averaged 81%, ranging from 67% to 87% across stand-age strata, and was higher for parcels predicted as non-OGF than OGF (Table S21 ).
blocks.zh: 在现有的四项研究中,我们模型的预测与Schickhofer & Schwarz(2019年)最为一致,后者是对甚高分辨率图像的实地校准专家解释,它将同样的OGF/非OGF类分配给AOI(Fig. S9)内83%的包裹. 与Schickhofer & Schwarz(2019年)共用部分来源的具有参考标签的包裹通过2001至2005年的库存(Veen等人,2010年)排除在外,协议的平均比例为81%,从67%到87%不等,预计非OGF的包裹比例高于OGF(表S21)。

blocks.en: 3.5. Area of applicability within the AOI and Carpathians
blocks.zh: 3.5. AOI和喀尔巴阡山脉内的适用区域

blocks.en: Within the AOI, 98.4% of forests were inside the area of applicability (AOA), with a median dissimilarity index (DI) of 0.238, well below the 0.443 threshold. Of the 9.90 Mha of forest across the entire Carpathian Mountain range, 6.44 Mha (65.0%) were inside the AOA (Fig. 7 ). At least 78% of Carpathian forests between 700 and 2,000 m in altitude were within the AOA, falling to 18.3% below 400 m and 32.0% above 2,000 m. Carpathian forests whose nearest training pixel was old-growth totalled 1.02 Mha, of which 68.8% were within the AOA; the 0.32 Mha of such forests outside the AOA indicates where the model is least supported and where additional reference labels would contribute most.
blocks.zh: 在AOI范围内,98.4%的森林位于适用区(AOA)内,中间差指数为0.238,远低于0.443阈值。 在整个喀尔巴阡山山脉的9.90兆赫森林中,6.44兆赫(65.0%)位于AOA内(图7)。 在海拔700至2,000米的喀尔巴阡山森林中,至少有78%在AOA范围内,下降到400米以下的18.3%,2000米以上为32.0%. 喀尔巴阡山森林的训练像素最近是老树种,总计1.02 Mha,其中68.8%在亚欧林区之内;亚欧林区以外的这种森林的0.32 Mha表明模型得到的支持最少,而其他的参考标签能做出最大贡献。

blocks.en: 4. Discussion
blocks.zh: 4. 讨论情况

blocks.en: 4.1. Overview

Existing maps varied widely both in their agreement with our reference labels and the extent to which they map OGF within the AOI. The two model-based products showed limited discrimination between OGF and non-OGF, resulting in a low PR-AUC, even though ROC-AUC closely matched their published values. The best-performing existing study used a field-calibrated expert interpretation of very-high-resolution imagery and set the benchmark for our locally trained model. Our models show that freely available satellite data contain an old-growth forest signal beyond what topographic and access predictors alone can determine, and that this signal survives spatial separation. Spatial separation did, however, affect the ranking of the EO-based feature sets. TESSERA outperformed conventional EO and AlphaEarth without a train-test buffer, but confidence intervals spanned zero once we imposed a 10 km buffer. Introducing spatial context through a CNN did not improve parcel-level detection at 10 m resolution. We provide raster and vector layers of our reference labels and old-growth predictions that cover the forested AOI.
blocks.zh: 现有地图在同意我们的参考标签和在阿拉伯石油倡议内绘制OGF地图的程度方面差异很大。 这两个基于模型的产品在OGF与非OGF之间的区别有限,导致PR-AUC低,尽管ROC-AUC与其公布的数值密切匹配. 现有最佳的研究成果采用了对甚高分辨率图像进行实地校准的专家解释,并为我们在当地培训的模型确定了基准。 我们的模型显示,可自由获取的卫星数据包含一个老的森林信号,超出仅地形和存取预测器所能确定的,而且这一信号在空间分离中生存。 然而,空间分离的确影响了基于环境功能的成套功能的排名。 TESSERA在没有火车测试缓冲器的情况下,超过了常规的EO和AlphaEarth, 但是一旦我们施加了10公里缓冲器,信任间隔就为零。 通过有线电视新闻网引入空间环境并没有改进10米分辨率的包裹级探测。 我们提供光栅和矢量层 我们的参考标签和老生长预测 覆盖森林的AOI。

blocks.en: 4.2. Knowing where old-growth forests are not
blocks.zh: 4.2. 了解旧生长的森林在哪里

blocks.en: Our evaluation of existing studies highlights the importance of true-negative labels for both performance assessment and model training. Sabatini (2020) and Munteanu et al. (2022) derive maps from models trained on presence-only labels, with negatives assumed from pseudo-absences or background points. This limitation is noted by Bubnicki et al. (2024) when mapping high-conservation-value forests in Sweden and is likely common across Europe, as labelled datasets, such as the European Primary Forest Database ( Sabatini et al., 2021 ) , focus on where the features of interest are rather than where they are not. Although ROC-AUC, the headline metric for the model-based studies, can rank positive-unlabelled models, precision and PR-AUC are confounded by assumed rather than confirmed negatives ( Bekker & Davis, 2020 ) . This is consequential when, as is the case for old-growth forests, the positive class is rare, because even a low false-positive rate can cause precision to collapse. Both Sabatini (2020) and Munteanu et al. (2022) reproduced their published ROC-AUC on our reference labels; however, precision and PR-AUC were low, and there was high overlap between their OGF and non-OGF prediction distributions. This limits their usefulness for parcel-level decisions within the AOI. True-negative labels are also a plausible contributor to the cleaner separation achieved by our models, likely supported by a heterogeneous mix of non-OGF labels spanning different forest types and terrain (Fig. S1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们对现有研究的评价突出表明,真正的负面标签对于业绩评估和模式培训都很重要。 萨巴蒂尼(2020年)和蒙泰阿努等人. 2022年(2022年)从接受过只存在标签培训的模型中获取地图,底片假设来自伪缺失或背景点. Bubnicki等人(2024年)在绘制瑞典高保护值森林地图时指出了这一局限性,而且在整个欧洲很可能会常见,如欧洲原始森林数据库(Sabatini等人,2021年)等标注数据集,侧重于感兴趣的特征在哪里而不是在哪里。 虽然ROC-AUC是模型研究的头条衡量标准,但可以对正无标签模型进行排名,精确度和PR-AUC通过假设而不是确认负数(Bekker & Davis, 2020)来混淆. 这是因为,与老林生长的情况一样,正率级是罕见的,因为即使是低的假阳性率也会导致精度崩溃。 Sabatini(2020年)和Munteanu等人(2022年)在我们的参考标签上转载了他们出版的ROC-AUC;然而,精确度和PR-AUC都很低,其OGF与非OGF的预测分布高度重叠. 这限制了它们在审计机关内部对包裹级决定的效用。 真阴性标签也是我们模型所实现的更清洁的分离的可信贡献,这种分离可能得到跨越不同森林类型和地形的非OGF标签(图S1)的不同组合的支持。

blocks.en: 4.3. EO outperforms simple topographic and access features
blocks.zh: 4.3. 道德操守办公室的业绩优于简单的地形和准入特征

blocks.en: Old-growth forest detection has been framed primarily as a structural measurement problem contingent on ALS-derived forest metrics, resulting in a body of work concentrated where ALS surveys exist ( Hirschmugl et al., 2023 ; Martin & Valeria, 2022 ; Fuhr et al., 2022 ; Adiningrat et al., 2024 ; Trouvé et al., 2024 ) . Although previous studies have demonstrated that old-growth forest detection is plausible from satellite EO alone ( Spracklen & Spracklen, 2019 ; Munteanu et al., 2022 ) , these studies have not isolated EO’s contribution beyond simple topography and access predictors (both of which can be derived from optical and radar data, Farr et al., 2007 ; Rolf et al., 2021 ). Our results show that predictive skill is attributable to optical and radar satellite data and is robust to spatial validation and train-test buffering. This presents a pathway to large-scale mapping of old-growth forests independent of ALS acquisition.
blocks.zh: 旧生长的森林探测主要被描述为结构测量问题,取决于ALS衍生的森林测量标准,结果形成了一套工作集中在存在ALS调查的地方(Hirschmugl等人,2023年;Martin & Valeria,2022年;Fuhr等人,2022年;Adiningrat等人,2024年;Trouvé等人,2024年)。 虽然以前的研究表明,仅从EO卫星(Spracklen & Spracklen, 2019年;Munteanu等人, 2022年)就可能发现老树林,但这些研究并没有将EO的贡献孤立于简单的地形和存取预测器之外(两者都可以从光学和雷达数据中得出,Farr等人,2007年;Rolf等人,2021年)。 我们的结果显示,预测技能可归因于光学和雷达卫星数据,而且对空间验证和列车测试缓冲能力很强。 这为大规模绘制独立于ALS获取的老森林图提供了途径。

blocks.en: 4.4. Spatial autocorrelation can inflate performance under blocked validation
blocks.zh: 4.4. 在被阻断的验证下,空间自动化可提高性能

blocks.en: Our results agree with previous findings that spatial blocking is necessary but not sufficient to control spatial autocorrelation ( Roberts et al., 2017 ; Ploton et al., 2020 ; Karasiak et al., 2022 ) . Our block sizes were informed by the spatial autocorrelation ranges measured in the reference labels and predictors, following guidance that these structures be assessed on the raw data rather than on residuals alone ( Roberts et al., 2017 ) . Larger blocks might have reduced residual spatial autocorrelation, but at the cost of fewer folds and less stable pooled estimates, and without resolving cross-fold parcel proximity at the block borders. Only train-test buffering can remove these pairs directly, and three diagnostics support 10 km as the buffer for spatially independent performance: the out-of-fold residual semivariogram range (4.5–6.5 km), the distance at which buffered performance stops falling relative to a parcel-matched control (8–10 km), and the distance at which the coordinate-only control falls to the no-skill floor (9 km). However, whether spatial autocorrelation should be controlled or exploited depends on the task. Spatial validation can be overly pessimistic when the modelling objective is interpolation rather than transfer ( Wadoux et al., 2021 ; Roberts et al., 2017 ) . We therefore compared feature sets and architectures using the 10 km buffered configuration, and predicted within the AOI using the unbuffered configuration, where unlabelled parcels sit among training parcels and spatial autocorrelation can be exploited justifiably ( Roberts et al., 2017 ; Kattenborn et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们的结果与先前的结论一致,即空间阻隔是必要的,但不足以控制空间自发性关系(Roberts等人,2017年;Ploton等人,2020年;Karasiak等人,2022年)。 我们的区块大小从参考标签和预测器中测量的空间自旋范围中得知,我们遵循的指导意见是,这些结构应依据原始数据而不是仅针对残留物进行评估(Roberts等人,2017年)。 较大的区块可能会减少剩余空间的自动化关系,但代价是折叠减少,集合估计更不稳定,而且不会解决区块边界的交叉包裹邻近问题。 只有列车测试缓冲器可以直接去除这些对子,三个诊断器支持10公里作为空间独立性能的缓冲器:双倍外剩余半变量范围(4.5–6.5公里),缓冲性能相对于一个包裹匹配的控制(8–10公里)停止下降的距离,以及仅坐标控制到无技能层(9公里)的距离. 然而,空间自动化关系是否应当加以控制或利用取决于任务。 当建模目标为内插而不是转移时,空间验证可能过于悲观(Wadoux等人,2021年;Roberts等人,2017年)。 因此,我们利用10公里缓冲配置来比较特征集和架构,并在AOI内部使用未缓冲配置来预测,未贴标签的包裹坐落在培训包裹中,空间自动连接可以被合理利用(Roberts等人,2017年;Kattenborn等人,2022年)。

blocks.en: Spatial validation and buffering can change or even reverse a study’s conclusions. Here, TESSERA’s advantage over conventional EO and AlphaEarth was no longer statistically significant once a 10 km buffer prevented the model from exploiting training parcels near the fold boundaries. The point estimates still favoured TESSERA, but the intervals were also consistent with no difference. This matters, particularly given the lower interpretability, higher storage requirements, and longer training times associated with high-dimensional inputs. TESSERA’s embeddings were calculated per pixel ( Feng et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2026a ) and exhibited spatial autocorrelation similar to that of AlphaEarth within our AOI, in both the embeddings and model residuals. The unbuffered comparative advantage is therefore unlikely to be attributable to spatial encoding within the embeddings and could instead arise from how our models exploit their spatial structure – an interaction that warrants further research.
blocks.zh: 空间验证和缓冲可以改变甚至推翻研究的结论. 在这里,TESSERA相对于常规EO和AlphaEarth的优势在统计学上已不再重要,因为10公里的缓冲剂使模型无法利用折叠边界附近的训练包裹。 点数估计仍然倾向于TESERA,但间隔也无差别。 这很重要,特别是考虑到可解释性较低,储存要求较高,与高维度投入相关的培训时间较长。 TESSERA的嵌入物按像素计算(Feng等人,2026年;Feng等人,2026年a),并在嵌入物和模型残基中表现出与我国大气有机物中的AlphaEarth相似的空间自转关系。 因此,不可阻挡的比较优势不可能归因于嵌入物中的空间编码,而是可能源于我们的模型如何利用它们的空间结构,这种相互作用值得进一步研究。

blocks.en: A recent systematic review of 1,122 geospatial AI and GFM studies recommends benchmarks for spatial generalisation, including out-of-region transfer ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) . Our findings illustrate this need and fall between two emerging strands in the literature. One reports that GFMs outperform hand-engineered optical and radar features ( Feng et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2026a ; Brown et al., 2025 ; Ball et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . The other finds limited spatial transferability for AlphaEarth embeddings compared to conventional EO on agricultural tasks ( Ma et al., 2026 ) , and lower performance for biomass estimation in regenerating forests ( Rojas-Lucero et al., 2026 ) . We therefore recommend that comparisons between GFM and conventional EO performance be interpreted with reference to the extent to which spatial independence was enforced.
blocks.zh: 最近对1,122项地理空间AI和GFM研究进行了系统审查,提出了空间通用基准,包括区域外转移(周等人,2026年)。 我们的研究结果说明了这一需要,并且介于文献中新出现的两个方面之间。 有一份报告称,GFM的性能超过了手动工程的光学和雷达特征(Feng等人,2026年;Feng等人,2026年a;Brown等人,2025年;Ball等人,2026年;Yang等人,2026年)。 另一种观点认为,与传统的农业任务EO相比,α地球嵌入的空间可转移性有限(Ma等人,2026年),再生森林生物量估计的性能较低(Rojas-Lucero等人,2026年)。 因此,我们建议参照空间独立性的落实程度来解释GFM和常规EO性能的比较。

blocks.en: 4.5. Spatial context introduced by CNNs adds no benefit at 10 m spatial resolution
blocks.zh: 4.5. CNN引入的空间环境在10米空间分辨率方面没有任何好处

blocks.en: Horizontal structural complexity is a widely accepted indicator of old-growth conditions ( Spies, 2004 ; Wirth et al., 2009 ; European Commission, 2023 ) . Spracklen & Spracklen (2019) found that adding Sentinel-derived grey-level co-occurrence matrix (GLCM) texture features improved overall accuracy by 3.3 percentage points, and Hirschmugl et al. (2026) ranked texture features among the most important in some sites. CNNs are therefore an intuitive model architecture for detecting old-growth conditions. This expectation did not hold in our experiments, however, which found that CNNs did not improve parcel-level performance for any feature set. While this may be due to pixel-to-parcel aggregation – we observed modest CNN gains for some configurations when assessed at the pixel level – it is more likely driven by spatial resolution. Our largest CNN spans 70 m, sufficient to contain the structural elements of old-growth stands. However, the textural information that a CNN can exploit diminishes once pixels are coarser than the objects of interest ( Woodcock & Strahler, 1987 ; Kattenborn et al., 2021 ) , and the horizontal structures that distinguish old-growth forests may be poorly resolved at 10 m resolution. In the primeval forests of the Ukrainian Carpathians, for example, 98% of natural canopy gaps are smaller than 200 m 2 ( Hobi et al., 2015 ) , roughly equal to two 10 m resolution pixels. Lalechère et al. (2024) further found that structural information in optical imagery degrades with coarser pixels. Our results therefore suggest that, at 10 m resolution, introducing spatial context via a CNN does not contribute more than the denoising that parcel aggregation already provides.
blocks.zh: 横向结构复杂度是一个被广泛接受的老生长条件指标(Spies,2004年;Wirth等人,2009年;欧盟委员会,2023年). Spracklen & Spracklen (2019年)发现,添加Sentinel衍生的灰度共聚物基质(GLCM)纹理特征提高了3.3个百分点的整体精度,Hirschmugl等人(2026年)将纹理特征列为一些网站最重要的特征. 因此,有线电视新闻网是一种直观的模型架构,用于检测老式生长条件. 然而,我们的实验中没有这种期望,实验发现CNN并没有改进任何功能集的包裹级性能. 虽然这可能是由于像素对像素的聚合 — — 在像素水平评估时我们看到一些配置的CNN的微小收益 — — 但更有可能是空间分辨率驱动。 我们最大的CNN跨度为70米,足以容纳老式增长的立体结构元素. 然而,一旦像素比感兴趣的对象更窄,CNN可以利用的纹理信息就会减少(Woodcock & Strahler,1987年;Kattenborn等人,2021年),分辨老林的横向结构在10米分辨率下可能解不开. 例如在乌克兰喀尔巴阡山脉的原始森林中,98%的天然树冠缺口小于200米2(Hobi等人,2015年),大约等于两个10米分辨率像素. Lalechère et al. (2024)进一步发现,光学图像中的结构信息会以凝土像素降解. 因此,我们的结果表明,在10米分辨率时,通过有线电视新闻网引入空间背景不会比取消包裹汇总已经提供的空间环境更有用。

blocks.en: 4.6. Limitations

Our results come from a single mountain beech–spruce landscape. While the area of applicability extends across 65% of the Carpathian forests, applicability refers to feature-space support rather than model accuracy, which was not tested outside the AOI or verified in the field. With the exception of Kathmann et al. (2017) , the existing studies we compared against use reference stands tracing back to a 2001–2005 inventory ( Veen et al., 2010 ) , from which Romania’s National Catalogue of Virgin and Quasi-Virgin Forests underlying our OGF reference labels was partially populated. This may have inflated the existing studies’ agreement with our reference labels. Because our reference labels are a non-probability sample, our performance metrics and intervals rely on the fitted predictor–label relationship holding beyond these labels ( Stehman & Foody, 2019 ) . The same constraint applies to our mapped extent, which is not adjusted for omission and commission errors, and whose interval reflects variability from resampling of our reference labels rather than a probability sample ( Olofsson et al., 2014 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们的成绩来自一个单一的山水鸟的景观。 虽然适用范围扩展到65%的喀尔巴阡山森林,但适用范围是指地物空间支持,而不是模型精度,没有在AOI之外进行测试,也没有在实地核实。 除了Kathmann等人(2017年)之外,我们与使用参考比较的现有研究可以追溯到2001-2005年的清单(Veen等人,2010年),从中,罗马尼亚作为我们OGF参考标签基础的《维尔京森林和准维尔京森林国家目录》得到了部分人口。 这可能会夸大现有研究与我们的参考标签。 因为我们的参考标签是非概率样本, 我们的性能度量和间隔依赖于这些标签之外的匹配预测器-标签关系( Stehman & Foody, 2019) 。 同样的制约也适用于我们所绘制的范围,而这一范围没有因遗漏和佣金错误而进行调整,其间隔反映了我们参考标签的复制而异于概率样本(Olofsson等人,2014年)。

blocks.en: 4.7. Implications for Europe-wide mapping
blocks.zh: 4.7. 对全欧洲制图的影响

blocks.en: We identify three priorities for future large-scale old-growth forest mapping. First, a greater diversity of reference labels is required, both with respect to new landscapes to expand models’ spatial generalisation and area of applicability, and to confirmed negatives to improve class separation and false-positive estimation. Second, old-growth mapping studies require common evaluation metrics ( Hirschmugl et al., 2023 ) , and these should be suited to low-prevalence contexts. With primary and old-growth forests representing less than 3% of Europe’s forests ( Barredo et al., 2021 ) , a continent-wide classifier with no skill can achieve 97% overall accuracy. Precision-recall metrics are essential for evaluating a model’s usefulness, and we recommend their widespread use for this task. Third, testing temporal transfer of models could exploit the advantage of repeat acquisitions offered by EO, including GFMs. This would enable old-growth forests not only to be mapped, but also to be monitored for loss and recovery over time.
blocks.zh: 我们确定了未来大规模老林区测绘的三个优先事项。 首先,在扩大模型的空间泛化和可适用性范围的新景观方面,以及在确认负面因素以改善分类分离和假阳性估计方面,都需要更加多样化的参考标签。 第二,旧的生长图绘制研究需要共同的评价尺度(Hirschmugl等人,2023年),这些尺度应适合低流行率的情况。 由于原始和旧生长的森林只占欧洲森林的不到3%(Barredo等人,2021年),一个全大陆没有技能的分类者能够达到97%的整体准确度。 精确召回的衡量标准对于评价一个模型的有用性至关重要,我们建议广泛使用这些指标来完成这项任务。 第三,测试模型的暂时转让可以利用道德操守办公室提供的重复获取的好处,包括GFM。 这将使老林不仅能够绘制地图,而且能够监测长期损失和恢复情况。

blocks.en: 5. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5.五. 结论

blocks.en: Mapping old-growth forests is a priority for biodiversity conservation in Europe and requires a detection method that is accurate at the forest parcel level yet deployable continent-wide. Here, we show that freely available satellite data can detect old-growth forests beyond topography and access predictors, and our best-performing configuration achieved a PR-AUC of 0.84 [95% CI 0.79–0.88] within the AOI. Although TESSERA outperformed conventional EO and AlphaEarth under unbuffered spatially blocked cross-validation, the three EO-derived feature sets’ performance was consistent with no difference when a 10 km buffer was introduced between the training and test labels. Adding spatial context via a CNN showed no advantage over a pixel-based XGBoost model with 10 m resolution predictors. Our results show that spatially blocked validation is necessary but not sufficient to control spatial autocorrelation, and that train-test buffering is required if the aim is transfer to unseen landscapes. While increased feature and model complexity, including GFMs, may yet yield gains in other contexts, our findings indicate that the limiting factors are the geographic diversity of reference labels and the inclusion of confirmed negatives. For the wider Carpathians, our area of applicability analysis identified the forests where our model was least supported and therefore where new reference labels would contribute most.
blocks.zh: 绘制老林图是欧洲生物多样性保护的优先事项,需要有一种在森林地块一级准确、但可在整个大陆部署的探测方法。 在这里,我们显示,可自由获取的卫星数据能够探测到地形和获取预测器以外的老森林,我们的最佳配置在AOI中实现了0.84[95% CI 0.79-0.88]的PR-AUC。 虽然TESSERA在无阻空间阻隔的交叉验证下表现优于常规EO和AlphaEarth,但三个EO衍生的特性集的性能在培训和测试标签之间引入10公里缓冲器时没有区别。 通过CNN添加空间上下文显示,相对于以像素为基础的XGBooost模型,10 m分辨率预测器没有优势. 我们的结果显示,空间屏蔽的验证是必要的,但不足以控制空间的自动化关系,如果将目标转移到看不见的景观,则需要火车测试缓冲。 虽然增加的特性和模型复杂性,包括全球调频,在其他情况下可能有所收获,但我们的调查结果表明,限制因素是参考标签的地域多样性和已确认的负数的列入。 对于更广泛的喀尔巴阡山人来说,我们的适用性分析确定了我们的模型得到的支持最少的森林,因此,新的参考标签对森林的贡献最大。

blocks.en: S2.1. Reference label construction: additional details
blocks.zh: S2.1节。 参考标签构建:其他细节

blocks.en: A parcel map of 16,199 forest parcel boundaries was used as the base geometry. Although revisions have been made to these boundaries since the layer’s compilation (c. 2018), this was the only accessible source providing a contiguous geometry of forest parcels across most of the AOI. The original parcel map contained 1,226 parcels with overlaps (1,129 overlapping pairs), which risked undermining label integrity through feature ambiguity, over-representation and information leakage. A rule-based de-overlap procedure was applied to remove duplicates and slivers. Combined with the removal of 506 parcels outside the AOI and 96 non-productive units (e.g. water bodies, clear-cuts), this resulted in a topologically clean layer of 15,515 parcels for use in the study. Of these 15,515 parcels, 72 contained no pixel centre and were excluded from the parcel-level classification maps, leaving 15,443 classified parcels in total.
blocks.zh: 以16,199块森林包裹边界的包裹图作为基数几何. 虽然自地层编译(c. 2018)以来对这些边界进行了修改,但这是提供覆盖大多数AOI的森林地块的毗连几何图案的唯一可获取的来源. 原始的包裹图中包含有重叠的1,226个包裹(1,129个重叠对),这有可能通过特征模糊,代表度过高和信息泄漏破坏标签的完整性. 采用了基于规则的消除重叠程序来消除重复和疏漏。 加上AOI以外的506个包裹和96个非生产单元(如水体,明挖)被移除,由此形成了地形清洁的15,515个包裹,用于研究. 在这15,515个包裹中,有72个包裹没有像素中心,被排除在包裹级分类图之外,共计剩下15443个分类包裹.

blocks.en: The parcel map polygons were enriched with average age and species composition attributes using seven vector layers containing public and private forest management plan data for planning periods between 2013 and 2025. Forest management plan polygons were spatially matched to parcel map polygons where the intersection overlapped at least 90% of both geometries. This threshold was selected to balance the risk of inaccurate matches against the risk of excluding marginally misaligned parcels. For each matched parcel, species composition ( compoz , compoz_act ), average age ( varsta or ta ), and management plan year ( an_amenaja , an ) attributes were transferred to new fields in the parcel map layer. Final average-age attributes were derived by applying data-cleaning and prioritisation rules to the original and enriched parcel map fields. The age and plan-year fields were coerced to numeric data types, with zeros treated as missing data, following expert advice from FCC. For each parcel, the final parcel age was selected from the dated record closest to 2020. Where two records were equally distant from 2020, the earlier one was preferred.
blocks.zh: 利用含有2013年至2025年规划期间公共和私人森林管理计划数据的7个矢量层,丰富了包裹图多边形的平均年龄和物种构成属性。 森林管理计划多边形在空间上与块状地图多边形相匹配,两者的交叉点至少重叠了90%。 选择这一门槛值是为了平衡不准确匹配的风险和排除略微错配的包裹的风险。 对于每个匹配的包裹,物种组成(compoz, compoz_act),平均年龄(varsta或ta),以及管理计划年份(a_amenaja, a)属性被转移到包裹图层的新字段. 最终平均年龄属性是通过对原始和浓缩的包裹地图字段适用数据清理和排序规则而得出的。 根据公平竞争委员会的专家建议,年龄和计划年字段被强迫数字数据类型,零作为缺失数据处理。 对于每个包裹,最后的包裹年龄是从最接近2020年的日期记录中选出的. 在两个记录与2020年相距同样遥远的地方,更倾向于较早的记录。
